about: Cases for a command that reports a project's status (conformance/README.md, How a project's status is judged). Each case is a small project; expected refusals and statuses are written from the rules, never taken from a kernel. What the command judged is compared with the reference, tools/project_status.py.

files.dodona.toml:
# a small project
[project]
name = "p"
config = "0.2"

[[binding]]
name = "checks"
capabilities = ["obligation.enumerate", "obligation.check"]
provider = "t.check"
match = ["m/*.txt"]   # the files checked

[[binding]]
name = "intents"
capabilities = ["intent.index"]
provider = "t.intents"
match = ["intents/[0-9]*.md"]

[[binding]]
name = "executor"
capabilities = ["run.submit"]
provider = "@site"

cases.name: an empty ledger has a report
cases.why: With nothing recorded the project is still reported: o1 has never run, i1 is a draft, and the required intent is not delivered.
